family: UECP + frozen supervised OPV2V GSPR on V2X-R

training.weather: one uniform Clean/Fog/Snow draw per cooperative frame per epoch; same weather all CAVs

selection: train_dev Clean O BEV AP70 maximum unrounded; exact tie earliest; every epoch; never829 validation

final_validation.history: Already repeatedly inspected in previous research; not independent blind validation

native_evaluation.metric: native BEV IoU, VOC2010 AP30/50/70, global_sort=False, fixed frame order
native_evaluation.O: weather-filtered official GT; original None-prediction skip
native_evaluation.O*: same weather GT without None-prediction skip
native_evaluation.F: same final predictions; fixed live Clean GT verified by IDs and corners against frozen D-1C
native_evaluation.direction: native postprocessor dm branch, original UECP num_bins2 dir_offset.7853

UECP.density_target: 1-min(current-weather selected local-source point count,10)/10; bilinear align_corners=False for auxiliary loss
UECP.auxiliary: original HybridUncertaintyLoss alpha.5 gamma2, 5x, added once to each fused/single criterion call
UECP.local_features: native source-range/self/FOV-selected XYZI; independent local voxelization; explicit source->ego transforms, no double projection
UECP.empty_cav: zero sparse padding only; never a GT hit or GSPR valid point

GSPR.aggregation: valid point sums -> spatial sums -> divide valid count; separate validity mask

E1.quality_labels: only optional provenance-bound simulator recorded point origins aligned to current-weather raw PCD rows; no unmatched-Clean=noise rule
E1.A: density count and saturated density coverage
E1.D: density + quality permuted within weather/density bins separately in fit and diagnosis
E1.predictor: fixed ridge1e-3, core-only standardization, clipped fraction prediction; squared error
E1.SUPPORTED: scene-macro A-C Brier gain lower95%>0 and mean>=.001, A-D mean<=.0005
E1.otherwise: INCONCLUSIVE; no noise AUROC; compatible E2/E3 may continue exploratory

variants.E2: 113-parameter identity-initialized logit adapter, controlled single-scale detach removal
variants.E2_original_detach: same adapter retrained with original detach
variants.E3_joint: C within-source masked pooling + cross-scale prior, adapted Q cross-source precision
variants.E3_coverage: C roles active, uniform cross-source quality; adapter output disabled
variants.E3_quality: binary validity for coverage roles, Q adapter sees constant coverage
variants.E3_shuffled: joint retrained with Q vectors permuted within CAV observed count bins
variants.E3_no_separation: single U+Q adapter and original multiscale structure, same architecture as E2, independently retrained
variants.E3_constant_quality: joint with constant Q features/base, all113 adapter parameters active, frozen GSPR computed then ignored

E3_masks: Observed source masks warped with quality/features; divide interpolated mass; precision masked before and after smoothing; per-cell normalize only over valid sources; all-missing residual/output zero; no learned extra detection head
gradient_audit: Original UGPrecisionFusion detaches U for precision only; original multiscale downsample and cross-scale confidence still differentiate U. E0 untouched. Controlled AST edit removes exactly one u_map.detach for E2/no-separation.
native_worker_RNG: Final evaluator constructs/discards native reference model solely to reproduce original post-construction RNG advancement, constructs UECP, then restores that Python/NumPy/Torch/HIP state before native workers start; no reference inference or pretrained transfer
smoke: two epochs x two effective updates for each detector variant; four real frames; independent output; native four-frame inference; expected optimizer-boundary interruption mid-E0-epoch1 compared to fresh uninterrupted epoch1; expected Clean-cache interruption; epoch2 optimizer/RNG replay for E0/E2/joint; excluded from scientific tables
local_validation: static compilation and Python/NumPy synthetic only; actual original-equivalence, losses, gradients, HIP, data, optimizer replay, native829 GT checked only on server
claim_limits: single seed fixed20epoch exploratory validation; negative AP does not fail pipeline; no automatic statistical significance/SOTA/test generalization claim
